Row.Text: "I call on you, Maponos, through the power of the gods below. With your magic, bind these men and all who would swear a false oath."
"Sabinus could have escaped to a foreign country, except that he had a wife, the best of all women. Her Gaulish name was Epona, which in Greek may be translated as Heroine."
"There, Vercingetorix, a young man of great power, urged his men to take up arms for the cause of common liberty, and after gathering a large force, he expelled his enemies."
